place.title: Kalkan White House
place.address: Kalkan, Süleyman Yılmaz Cd. No:24, 07960 Kaş/Antalya, Türkiye

reviews.snippet: Отель очень милый, весь утопает в цветах. Находится в 3 минутах от городского пляжа и центральных улочек. В номерах есть фен, гель для душа, шампунь и мыло. Не хватает холодильника. Но зато много вешалок в шкафу, чему я была очень рада 😁. Завтраки однообразные и скучные. Только два кусочка сыра, яичница, хлеб и одна булочка на двоих. В основном только фрукты. Работники все приятные , но цены в отеле дорогие. Взяли 0.5 воду и одну соду- 60 лир .

Fabulous place to stay, Halil, Marion and the rest of the team were great host's, well done to you all. The breakfast was perfect and really sets you up for the day, spent many an hour in the courtyard, which is idyllic, with Halil providing me with an history of the area. Can't recommend the the hotel enough... we will return I'm sure.

A wonderful 8 night stay at The Courtyard, Marion, Halil and team are great hosts and nothing is too much for them. The gardens are beautiful and the rooms super clean and comfortable, the breakfast each morning on the terrace looking over the bay is a highlight itself with a beautiful fruit plate, cheese and egg of your choice. The location is also great being in the Old Town just five mins walk to the harbour and with many of the great restaurants with roof terraces right on the doorstep, in fact we didn’t use a taxi for our entire stay other than to and from the airport. Thank you for a truly relaxing and special trip.
Beautiful place, centrally located. The owners and staff are amazing. Going back for the 3rd year running in July. Highly recommend

We stayed here one night on our hike on the Lycian Way. The guesthouse/our room and gardens were beautiful. The afternoon tea and cookies were a lovely treat. And the breakfast was delicious. And Marion and Halil were wonderful hosts. We wish we could’ve stayed longer and we would definitely come again if we return to Kalkan.

Always love the White House, central, safe and friendly. Great Mediterranean breakfast, clean rooms that get serviced everyday. Great coffee/tea amenities. 10ft away from central Kalkan but with no noise. Beautiful courtyard. Marian and team make the stay excellent with knowledge, helpfulness and around the clock care. Views from terrace are beautiful and rooms are the perfect size. 10/10 would recommend to anyone, hidden gem.

We couldn’t fault the place.A very relaxed atmosphere with incredibly friendly staff who without asking were always happy to help and go that extra mile.Clean and comfortable with a large,fulfilling breakfast which sets you up for the day.Easy access to beach,restaurants and nightlife.We will be back……….Thankyou
